method: After the wire runs, each local topology's log file was searched for every lab bearer, the writer HMAC secret and the store secret. Field names were counted; values were never copied out of the logs.

topologies.logs: reader 66,761 B / writer 37,828 B (shim pino logs)
topologies.correlation: pino reqId per request (internal only; never returned to the client)

topologies.authorizationHeaderLogged: masked as *redacted* in request header dumps
topologies.artifactTagLogged: the x-artifact-tag value appears in full in request header dumps (16 lines); it is an HMAC, not a key
topologies.correlation: request_id on every line; OTLP export disabled in the lab

limits: Artifact-content redaction was checked on the AWS lab with a marker body; local bodies were random bytes and are not searchable.
The policy gateway itself logs nothing.
